en.html:
Kanae Were you hoping to hide like that and let me pass...? Numbers One to SixSix of the Rakuoujin.
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 Neither hiding nor letting you pass is our intention. This is our battle formationstance—
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 The formation by which we shall take your life, Lady Kanae. With respect, you are already within the two wingsencirclement of our force. The contest is decided.
Kanae ...Such declarations are not to be made before the fighting, you know. One invites misfortune that way.
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 Two or three of us will perish. The remainder, however, will receive your head.
Kanae Such confidence. Or should I call it such loyalty? To follow Shishiku blindly, to this extent.
Kanae The Major General of Twilight must be delighted in his grave. The founding ambition—to support the Kansei Reforms from the shadows, for the world and its people—where have you thrown that away?
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 That is a great misunderstanding... From the beginning, we have had no ambition of our own.
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 Human, yet not human. We are those appointed to be tools. Expendable stones, to be cast as our master wills.
Kanae ............
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 Ambition is unnecessary. Nor do we pick and choose our master. We Rakuoujin are taken into the hands of whoever desires us, and used—
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 Then, with your leave!!
en.text:
Kanae
Were you hoping to hide like that and let me pass...? Numbers One to SixSix of the Rakuoujin.




ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣
Neither hiding nor letting you pass is our intention. This is our battle formationstance—


ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣
The formation by which we shall take your life, Lady Kanae. With respect, you are already within the two wingsencirclement of our force. The contest is decided.


Kanae
...Such declarations are not to be made before the fighting, you know. One invites misfortune that way.




ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣
Two or three of us will perish. The remainder, however, will receive your head.


Kanae
Such confidence. Or should I call it such loyalty? To follow Shishiku blindly, to this extent.


Kanae
The Major General of Twilight must be delighted in his grave. The founding ambition—to support the Kansei Reforms from the shadows, for the world and its people—where have you thrown that away?




ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣
That is a great misunderstanding... From the beginning, we have had no ambition of our own.


ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣
Human, yet not human. We are those appointed to be tools. Expendable stones, to be cast as our master wills.


Kanae
............




ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣
Ambition is unnecessary. Nor do we pick and choose our master. We Rakuoujin are taken into the hands of whoever desires us, and used—


ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣
Then, with your leave!!

ja.html:
香奈枝 「そうして隠れて、やり過ごすつもりだった のかしら……？ 　楽翁陣の壱から陸ろく」
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 「隠れるつもりも、やり過ごすつもりもござ らん。これは我らの戦形かまえ――」
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 「香奈枝様を討ち取るための陣にござる。 　恐れながら、あなた様は既に我らの両翼かこいの 中。勝負は決し申した」
香奈枝 「……そういう言葉は戦う前に言ったらいけ ませんのに。 　不幸を招いてしまいましてよ？」
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 「二人ないし三人は果てるでござろう。 　しかし残りの者があなた様の首を頂戴致し まする」
香奈枝 「大した自信。いえ、大した忠誠というべき なのかしら。 　そうまでして獅子吼に盲従するなんて」
香奈枝 「黄昏の少将も草葉の陰でお喜びでしょうね。 　世のため人のため、寛政の御改革を闇から 支えんとした創立の志は、どこに捨ててしま われましたの？」
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 「それは大いなる誤解と申すもの……。 　元より、我らに志などござらぬ」
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 「我らは人にして人にあらず。道具たるべく 定められた者ども。 　主の意のままに放られる、捨石にござる」
香奈枝 「…………」
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 「志など無用。主の選り好みも致さぬ。 　我ら楽翁陣は我らを欲する主の手に取られ、 使われるのみ――」
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 「なれば御免!!」
